title: Broaden the specialist roles and modelling roles in 4.5.2
requirements:
- Add or locate missing capabilities (AI governance, platform operations, service and product management, procurement, clinical safety, cybersecurity operations)
- Make the modeller role standard-neutral, with FHIR profiling as one specialism
- Distinguish architecture responsibilities and treat migration as a multidisciplinary workstream
- Include ongoing maintenance, classification and clinical-coding responsibilities
- Assign clinical-safety and AI-assurance accountability explicitly
- Describe semantic governance as multidisciplinary rather than owned by terminology specialists alone
